caption: The drawing features two wooden chests, one depicted above the other, each presented in a front-facing view. The upper object is a rectangular chest with three sections along the top: the left and right panels display carved symmetrical designs, while the central octagonal panel contains an elaborate floral or geometric carving. Flanking these panels are sets of turned spindles or columns painted black. Below these are two large horizontal drawers, each divided into three sections, with black oval pulls and black geometric decorations around the handles. The wood is tan or light brown with visible grain and reddish-brown trim accents along edges and intersections, as well as some additional black vertical accents. The chest sits on four squared legs. The lower object is a smaller, simpler chest composed of a large upper drawer with a single black oval pull centered, bordered with reddish-brown linear trim and black corner accents, and a two-door cabinet section beneath, each door showing a natural wood grain with light brown and tan coloration. The chest also has squared legs and black trim near the base. The drawing includes small, neat handwriting in the lower left with a description, and a signature with a date in the lower right. The background is a plain, unadorned off-white.
title: Tulip and Sunflower Chest
